articles.title: Implementation of APAAR ID across Higher Educational Institutions
articles.summary: Ministry of Education evaluates national rollout of One Nation One Student ID (APAAR) to streamline academic mobility.
prelims: APAAR stands for Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry.
Linked directly to the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) system.
Operates under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 framework.
articles.mains: Examine how Digital Public Infrastructure in education enhances transparency, reduces dropouts, and supports lifelong learning.

articles.title: Expansion of India Semiconductor Mission (ISM 2.0)
articles.summary: Cabinet approves Phase 2 of the India Semiconductor Mission to focus on equipment manufacturing and critical raw materials.
prelims: ISM is an independent Business Division within Digital India Corporation.
Phase 1 focused on Fab setting and ATMP (Assembly, Testing, Marking, and Packaging).
Phase 2 targets indigenous supply chain resilience and specialized chemical production.
articles.mains: Discuss the strategic imperative of semiconductor self-reliance in ensuring national cybersecurity and economic resilience.

articles.title: NDMA Deploys Integrated Early Warning Systems for GLOFs in the Himalayas
articles.summary: National Disaster Management Authority establishes high-altitude sensor networks to monitor vulnerable glacial lakes.
prelims: GLOFs occur when a dam containing a glacial lake fails, releasing massive water volumes downstream.
High-altitude automatic weather stations (AWS) provide real-time water level and weather telemetry.
Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand are prioritized for initial deployment.
articles.mains: Analyze the impact of climate change on Himalayan hydrology and assess disaster preparedness mechanisms against Glacial Lake Outburst Floods.

articles.title: India-Nordic-Baltic 8 (NB8) Cooperation on Maritime & Digital Security
articles.summary: India and NB8 nations launch a joint initiative focused on green shipping, maritime technology, and cyber resilience.
prelims: NB8 comprises Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, and Sweden.
Focus areas include green transition, digital connectivity, and Indo-Pacific maritime security.
Enhances bilateral cooperation between India and Northern European regional groupings.
articles.mains: Evaluate the strategic significance of India's enhanced diplomatic engagement with the Baltic and Nordic regions.

articles.title: Revised Framework Guidelines for the Green Credit Programme (GCP)
articles.summary: MoEFCC updates guidelines prioritising holistic ecosystem restoration over simple monoculture afforestation.
prelims: GCP was launched under the LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) initiative.
Administered by the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE).
Green Credits operate independently from mandatory Carbon Credits under the CCTS.
articles.mains: Critically analyze market-based instruments like the Green Credit Programme in balancing ecological restoration with industrial growth.
